leaderboards.label: Reported qubit count
leaderboards.explanation: Higher reported qubit count ranks to the right. This is a scale descriptor, not a universal quality score; source terminology differs by QPU.

leaderboards.label: Quantum Volume
leaderboards.explanation: Higher Quantum Volume ranks to the right. Compare only implementations using the stated Quantum Volume protocol and confidence criterion.

leaderboards.label: CLOPS
leaderboards.explanation: Higher Circuit Layer Operations Per Second ranks to the right. Compare only matching CLOPS methodology and workload configuration.

leaderboards.label: Reported 1Q gate fidelity
leaderboards.explanation: Higher reported 1Q gate fidelity ranks to the right. Calibration and aggregation procedures can differ between vendors.

leaderboards.label: Reported 2Q gate fidelity
leaderboards.explanation: Higher reported 2Q gate fidelity ranks to the right. Gate family and characterization method must be checked before interpreting close values.

leaderboards.label: LogicBit average F_SQ
leaderboards.explanation: Higher dashboard-reported average F_SQ ranks to the right. This comparison is limited to targets reporting this same dashboard label.

leaderboards.label: LogicBit average F_CZ
leaderboards.explanation: Higher dashboard-reported average F_CZ ranks to the right. This comparison is limited to targets reporting this same dashboard label.

leaderboards.label: LogicBit average logical error rate
leaderboards.explanation: Lower dashboard-reported logical error rate ranks to the right. Interpret only with the code, task and protocol settings that accompany the dashboard value.
